what: Online track finder for the pion spectrometer: momentum map, channel table, one-track light, finder constants.
readout_note: winner-takes-all inside a cluster: a reading's channel is its largest-light channel. Channels 1-based.
map_note: exported: rows with n_cal >= 5 (finder.map_min_n; online_finder.load applies the same cut). ok = 1 when n_cal >= 15 (sigma measured from enough calibration tracks).
map_calibration: flat-momentum pion library through the detector model with fluctuating light at the threshold below (19 build_map.py); simulation, to be replaced by beam calibration
planes_note: distance along the arm from the target to each plane's strip centre; T1/T2 move between settings sideways only, so these are the same for both
gate_note: a channel's hit counts when its measured time is within +-10 ns of the clock-expected arrival of a beta = 0.75 pion at that plane (applied before the finder)

finder.sigma_t_note: per-channel time resolution by gang width; PLACEHOLDER = rise time / 4 (rise {1: 5.0, 2: 7.142857142857142, 4: 11.428571428571429, 8: 20.0} ns, user 2026-09-30)

counters.entrance_veto: two 5 mm scintillator panels, 64 mm square, hole = aperture (36 x 65 mm); 0.1 MeVee per panel; fired on an accepted bunch -> status veto
counters.gas_cherenkov: one bit per bunch; fired on an accepted bunch -> status electron
counters.lucite: 3 cm behind T2; TAG only (offline), never rejects
